scope: Password zips, several attachments at once, and more places for File manager to start.

topics.title: Zip files with a password
details: Alt+U now opens a zip file that has a password. Companion asks you to type it.
Alt+Shift+Z makes a zip file with a password. You type the password twice.
Passwords are typed in a private box. Companion never says or saves them.

topics.title: Save several attachments at once
details: In the Attachments list, press Space to tag a file. Control+A tags them all.
Control+S saves every tagged file in Downloads. Control+D saves them in a folder you name.

topics.title: More places for File manager to start
details: In File manager options, you can start in any drive or cloud folder on this computer.
That includes a USB drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and Google Drive. Only places that are on this computer are listed.

topics.title: Attach several files
details: Tag files with Space or Control+A, even in different folders, then attach them all at once.
If you tag a folder too, the files are attached and Companion tells you the folder was left out.
